events.details: Chasing Abbey About Chasing Abbey Irish trio Chasing Abbey are known for their groundbreaking fusion of electronic production and Celtic influences, in particular Irish traditional music. At the forefront of the Irish language revival, Chasing Abbey use this beautiful ancient language to deliver their lyrics with maximum weight. Their live show is just as much a spiritual awakening as it is a concert performance – soaring energy mixed with a message of unity and social justice drives home the feeling that this is not just a show, this is a movement. events.details: East Oxford Farmers’ & Community Market About the East Oxford Farmers’ & Community Market The East Oxford Farmers’ & Community Market is a small, friendly local market with plenty of fresh food, delicious sweet and savoury takeaways, dried foods, and a plant-based café. The market also features stalls non-food stalls selling antiques, scarves and shawls, non-plastic household goods, and makeup, plus cleaners and detergents. The majority of the producers are from within 30 miles of Oxford. The market began in August 2006 with just six stalls, and it has since grown into a local institution.…

events.name: North Parade Market on 2nd Saturdays
events.details: North Parade Market Oxford About the North Parade Market Established in July 2012, the first market was held the following October. Since then, market has quickly become one of the most highly regarded markets in the North Oxford area. The market features organic and artisan producers from the local area, who bring life and colour to this pleasant avenue in the central north Oxford area. The North Parade Market takes place every 2nd and 4th Saturday of the month on North Parade Avenue which runs between the Woodstock Road (Church Walk, leading to North Parade Avenue) and Banbury Road.
events.address: North Parade Avenue, North Parade Avenue, Oxford, Oxfordshire, OX2 6LX
